text:
maya: Anyone else seeing the onboarding sample crash on a Workers/edge deploy with the ESM SDK bundle? Error about ambiguous overloads + missing Authorization header.
ryan: I hit the same. TS build fails in the sample app with TS2345 — looks like generics/overloads are being chosen badly (unknown vs any).
maya: Minimal repro in client.ts: ```ts
// client.ts
export const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'redwood-alpha', messages: [...] });
```
sam: The underlying issue: when the package is consumed as ESM vs CJS + different moduleResolution settings, TypeScript ends up pulling two copies of the SDK types. That creates overlapping overloads where one signature uses `unknown` generics and another uses `any`. The compiler can't pick and fails.
hannah: For me it was `moduleResolution: "bundler"` in the sample tsconfig. Switching to `node` removed the duplicate types (node resolution found the single copy) — weird but consistent with how bundlers hoist.
maya: Confirmed. Changing tsconfig to: ```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "moduleResolution": "node",
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "preserveSymlinks": false
  }
}
``` fixed the build locally. Also deduped node_modules by forcing one sdk copy.
ryan: We should update the sample templates. Also consider adding `typesVersions` and explicit `exports`/`types` fields in package.json so ESM/CJS consumers get the same typedef entrypoint.
ci-bot: Created issue RW-3421: "sample-js edge: tsconfig causes duplicate types & overload errors" assigned to @sam
sam: Additionally there's a runtime auth quirk: in ESM edge deployments the Authorization header wasn't being attached for some customers because our CJS fallback path mutates the request in a different lifecycle. Quick workaround: set auth via `client.options.headers` or set env var `REDWOOD_AUTH` in worker. We'll patch SDK to normalize header injection for both module systems.
maya: I'll draft a PR to update the sample `wrangler.toml` + `tsconfig.json` and add a note to onboarding docs: prefer `moduleResolution: node` for edge samples and explicitly cast generics when consuming public SDK types (e.g., `client.chat.create<MyShape>(...)`) to avoid inference surprises.
ryan: Good. Also add CI build matrix that compiles sample with both `moduleResolution: node` and `bundler` and with esbuild/webpack to catch regressions.
hannah: :thumbsup: I'll add to infra matrix and a smoke test that checks the Authorization header is present in the edge runtime.
sam: Thanks all — summary & links in RW-3421. TL;DR: update sample tsconfig, add note in onboarding, normalize auth header codepath, add CI coverage to catch duplicate-type overloads.
